text.zh_cn:
# 篝火
疲惫的旅人，坐下吧。
在这由方块砌成的世界里，**床**便是你的篝火。
- 右击床，即可设置重生点
- 夜晚入睡，可跳过漫漫长夜
> 但切记，深渊之中亦有安眠，只是不再醒来。
---
携带 [item:minecraft:bed]，让每一次倒下都有归处。
text.en_us:
# Bonfire
Rest, weary traveler.
In this world of blocks, the **bed** is your bonfire.
- Right-click a bed to set your spawn point
- Sleep through the long night
> But know: there are beds in the Abyss from which one never wakes.
---
Carry [item:minecraft:bed], so every fall has a place to return to.
